  • Method Details

    • switchScreen

      public static void switchScreen(Node source, String fxmlPath, String title) throws IOException
      Switches the current window to a different screen by loading (or reusing) an FXML-based scene.

      This method uses a scene cache to avoid reloading FXML files and recreating scenes multiple times. Each scene is stored using the base FXML file name (without extension) as a unique key.

      If the requested scene already exists in the cache, it is reused. Otherwise, the FXML file is loaded, a new Scene is created, and stored for future use.

      The screen switch is performed on the current Stage obtained from the provided source node.

      Parameters:
      source - a JavaFX node that belongs to the current scene (typically event.getSource())
      fxmlPath - the relative path to the FXML file (e.g. "/Order/OrderForm.fxml")
      title - the title to set on the application window
      Throws:
      IOException - if the FXML file cannot be loaded

    • addToSceneManager

      public static void addToSceneManager(Scene scene, String fxmlPath)
      Adds a Scene to the scene cache using the base FXML file name as the key.

      This method allows scenes to be manually registered in the scene manager, enabling reuse of already created scenes without reloading their associated FXML files.

      The scene is stored using the FXML file name (without the ".fxml" extension) extracted from the provided path.

      Parameters:
      scene - the Scene instance to store in the scene cache
      fxmlPath - the relative path to the FXML file associated with the scene (e.g. "/Order/OrderForm.fxml")

    • isPasswordValid

      public static boolean isPasswordValid(String password)
      Validates whether a given password meets the application's password requirements.

      A valid password must satisfy all of the following rules:

      • Contains at least 8 characters
      • Contains at least one uppercase letter (A–Z)
      • Contains at least one lowercase letter (a–z)
      • Contains at least one digit (0–9)
      • No special characters are required
      • No spaces are allowed

      If the password is null, empty, or does not match the validation pattern, this method returns false.

      Parameters:
      password - the password string to validate
      Returns:
      true if the password meets all the requirements; false otherwise

    • showMessage

      public static void showMessage(String title, String message)
      Displays an information alert dialog with the specified title and message.

      This method creates a JavaFX Alert of type Alert.AlertType.INFORMATION, sets its title and content text, and then shows it modally using Dialog.showAndWait().

      Parameters:
      title - the title of the alert dialog window
      message - the message to display in the alert content

    • showSelectableMessage

      public static void showSelectableMessage(String title, String header, String content)
      Displays an informational alert with selectable text content.

      This method creates a JavaFX Alert of type INFORMATION and sets a TextArea as its content, allowing the user to select and copy the text. The TextArea's size is dynamically adjusted to match the length of the content while respecting maximum width and height limits.

      The text area is non-editable and wraps long lines automatically.

      Parameters:
      title - the title of the alert window
      header - the header text displayed at the top of the alert
      content - the main content text to display in a selectable TextArea
